findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done. The client screenshot shows the first screen ending at about 851px while Needs you and Blocked or slow contain only placeholder lines. Replacing those placeholders with the promised five Needs you rows and two blocked rows adds well over the remaining 49px. The five-row limit therefore does not keep a normal populated board within the required 900px screen.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Functional. Both 390px Forge screenshots show the Today and end-date labels running together as “Today8 October.” The mobile layout puts both labels on the same track without reserving space between them, obscuring the date on a normal narrow screen.
findings.title: Mobile time-axis labels overlap

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Test. The added trends assertion parses generated HTML; it never opens the trends section in a browser, and it checks person rows without asserting the required team row. The Playwright check in test_board_runway.py only exercises the first screen. The visible six-week trends and around-Forge list can therefore break in the browser while these tests pass.

findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 4, Harm 1
The current team facts leave Needs you and Blocked or slow null, so the new screen displays “Not worked out by this release” for both. The first-screen test accepts those nulls and does not yet exercise its stated seven waits and two blocked rows. This needs the WAITS task's data before the populated-list proof can run.
